title: 13131 Imports Recalls Red Apple Fireworks Brand "American Glory" and "Merica AF" Fireworks Due to Explosion and Burn Hazards; Violation of Federal Firework Safety Standards
summary: The recalled shell fireworks can explode prematurely, posing explosion and burn hazards to consumers and bystanders. Units: About 2,400.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR XP Turbo and Turbo S Recreational Off-Road Vehicles Due to Fire and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicle's clutch can fracture, causing fragments to be ejected from the vehicle, posing fire and injury hazards. Units: About 27,300 (In addition, about 660 were sold in Canada) (Some of these vehicles were previously recalled in November 2020 and in December 2021).

title: Recall of Polaris Off-Road Vehicles, Bobcat Utility Vehicles, Gravely Utility Vehicles, and Fuel Pump Kits and Fuel Tank Assemblies Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A fuel leak can occur at the fuel pump outlet connector on the fuel tank near a hot surface, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 12,300 (In addition, about 517 were sold in Canada) (Some of these vehicles were previously recalled in March 2021 and July 2021 for different hazards).

title: Restwell Mattress Recalls Room & Board Crib Mattresses Due to Suffocation Hazard for Infants; Failure to Comply with Federal Safety Standard for Crib Mattresses; Sold Exclusively at Room & Board (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled crib mattresses fail to comply with multiple provisions of the Federal Safety Standard for Crib Mattresses, including the firmness test and missing warnings and labels. The product poses a suffocation hazard to infants. Units: About 100.

title: Saxco International Recalls Carboys Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass can break due to improper cooling processes, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 8,370.

title: Sensio Recalls Bella, Bella Pro Series, Cooks and Crux Electric and Stovetop Pressure Cookers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The pressure cooker's lid can unlock and be removed during use, causing the hot contents to unexpectedly splash out, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 860,000.

title: Target Recalls 2.2 Million Threshold Candles Due to Laceration and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The candle's jar can crack or break during use, posing laceration and burn hazards. Units: About 2.2 million.

title: The Children's Place Recalls Two Styles of Baby and Toddler Boy Basic Stretch Straight Leg Jeans Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The metal snaps on the jeans can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 97,400 (In addition, about 1,800 of one style were sold in Canada).

title: American Honda Recalls Portable Generators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel filler cap can improperly seal, resulting in fuel and/or fuel vapor leaking, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 250.

title: Crate & Barrel Recalls Table Lamps Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A loose electrical cord connection in the lamps can pose a fire hazard. Units: About 600.

title: Daikin Comfort Technologies Recalls Amana Packaged Terminal Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps Due to Burn and Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The DigiAir module compressor can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 62,100 (In addition, about 302 were sold in Canada).

title: Maggie's Farm Recalls Aerosol Bed Bug & Flea Killer Cans Due to Injury and Laceration Hazards
summary: The pressurized aerosol bed bug and flea killer cans can rupture and expel shrapnel, posing injury and laceration hazards to consumers. In addition, leakage of contents can pose a risk of skin and eye irritation upon contact. Units: About 14,500.

title: Philips Avent Digital Video Baby Monitors Recalled by Philips Personal Health Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The rechargeable lithium-ion batteries in the Parent Unit monitors can overheat during charging, posing a risk of burns and property damage. Units: About 12,850.

title: Aiper Elite Pro Cordless Robotic Pool Vacuum Cleaners Recalled Due to Burn and Fire Hazards; Distributed by Shenzhen Aiper Intelligent Co. (Recall Alert)
summary: When the charging cord is plugged into the device without the adapter and/or directly into the charging port on the machine, the battery can overheat and short circuit, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 22,000 (In addition, about 50 were sold in Canada and about four were sold in Mexico).

title: Multi-Purpose Kids Bike Helmets Recalled Due to Risk of Head Injury, Failure to Meet Bicycle Helmet Standard Requirements; Sold by Ecnup Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the coverage, positional stability, and labeling requirements of the CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 215.

title: Costco Recalls Ubio Labs Power Banks Due to Fire Hazard; Caught Fire on Commercial Flight (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled power banks can overheat and ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 350,000.

title: Midwest Lubricants Recalls Sodium Hydroxide Products Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Packaging and FHSA Labeling Requirements (Recall Alert)
summary: The product contains sodium hydroxide, which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). title: The Simplay3 Company Recalls Toddler Towers Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The towers can tip over while in use posing fall and injury hazards to young children. Units: About 108,450 (In addition, 5,512 in Canada).

title: Zipadee Kids Recalls Convertible House Bed Frames and Montessori Floor Beds Due to Entrapment and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The spindles used on the recalled beds are spaced at a distance that creates a serious entrapment hazard that can lead to strangulation and/or death to children. title: Gree Recalls 1.56 Million Dehumidifiers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Reports of At Least 23 Fires
summary: The dehumidifiers can overheat, smoke, and catch fire, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 1.56 million.

title: Apollo Recalls Phantom Electric Scooters Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The bolt on the electric scooter can come loose causing the suspension and wheel assembly to separate, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 3,900.

title: Bombardier Recreational Products (BRP) Recalls Ski-Doo and Lynx Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The main injector fuel return hose can leak, posing a fire hazard. This can also result in serious property damage, injuries or even death. Units: About 4,070 (In addition, about 3,100 were sold in Canada).

title: Chemboys Recalls DIYChemicals Potassium and Sodium Hydroxide Products Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Packaging Requirement and Violation of FHSA Labeling Requirement (Recall Alert)
summary: The products contain potassium hydroxide and sodium hydroxide which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). title: Electrolux Group Recalls Frigidaire Gas Cooktops Due to Risk of Gas Leak, Fire Hazard
summary: Plastic control knobs with a black shaft on the cooktop can crack or break during use, posing a risk of gas leak, fire hazard. Units: About 215.

title: Polaris Recalls MATRYX PRO RMK and MATRYX RMK KHAOS Snowmobiles Due to Serious Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The handlebar hooks on the recalled snowmobiles pose a puncture hazard and risk of serious injury if the rider's body impacts the handlebar hook during a crash. Units: About 15,900 (In addition, about 7,040 were sold in Canada) (These vehicles were previously recalled in May 2023 for a different haz

title: Prime-Line Recalls Glass Doorknobs Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The recalled glass doorknobs can crack and separate from the doorknob assembly, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 167,000 (In addition, about 10,265 were sold in Canada).

title: TOMY Recalls Boon Flair and Flair Elite Highchairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bolts used to secure the seat of the recalled highchair to the pedestal base can become loose and allow the seat to detach, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 83,000 (In addition, about 2,850 were sold in Canada).
